facts.fact: The Centre gabonais de l'innovation and UNDP signed a partnership in Libreville to launch TechSpace Masuku, a technology incubator at the Universite des sciences et techniques de Masuku, with a programme to train more than 300 young people; no cohort is yet reported.

systems.owner: Centre gabonais de l'innovation, UNDP, USTM
